scripts.css:build: tailwindcss -i apps/shell/src/tailwind.input.css -o apps/shell/src/tailwind.generated.css && tailwindcss -i apps/products/src/tailwind.input.css -o apps/products/src/tailwind.generated.css && tailwindcss -i apps/cart/src/tailwind.input.css -o apps/cart/src/tailwind.generated.css
scripts.build:remotes: npm run build:cart && npm run build:products
scripts.dev: npm run build:remotes && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names cart,products,shell --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,green "npm run serve:cart" "npm run serve:products" "npm run serve:shell"
